  const isEditMode = id && id !== 'new';
  const loggedInUser = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('smartflow_user') || '{}');

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    id: null,
    code: '',
    name: '',

    issuer: loggedInUser.full_name || '',
